notes:
- The Outskirts' final boss is now the Alpha, its own monster instead of Sir Chonk: a huge, pale stalker
  with red eyes and bone spikes down its back. It hunts low, hits twice as hard as a zombie and leaps at you
  from up to 13 m away. It has its own health bar, and its limbs can't be shot off.
- The Outskirts is now a forested town: Cedar Hollow, a logging town deep in the pines. A thick pine forest
  surrounds it, log cabins with stone chimneys line its edge, and the fog is greener.
- Car batteries now come from cars in the Mayday quest: look for the three cars parked on the streets
  with their hoods up, and pull the battery out of the engine bay.
- The Play menu is now picture cards: Solo, Find Game and Host Game, like the map selection screen.
- The main menu's background now cycles through the maps: every 40 s it fades to a scene from another
  map (the Prison, the Outskirts, the Lab and the Hospital).
- Perk cards: walk up to a perk machine and a card pops out on the right with its icon, what it does,
  the price and the upgrades you've bought for it.
- Fixed: Hospital Screamers made zombies far too fast, and with two of them shrieking in turns the
  zombies near them hardly ever slowed down. A shriek now speeds zombies up by 40%, capped below your sprint
  speed. It can't be applied twice, always wears off, and leaves them winded for 6 s before another
  shriek works on them. Bosses ignore it.
- The boss bar now names the quest bosses (Warden Cole, Patient Zero, the Alpha) instead of always
  saying Sir Chonk.
